title: To Bubble or Not to Bubble: Asset Price Dynamics and Optimality in OLG Economies
abstract: arXiv:2508.03230v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study an overlapping generations (OLG) exchange economy with an asset that yields dividends. First, we derive general conditions, based on exogenous parameters, that give rise to three distinct scenarios: (1) only bubbleless equilibria exist, (2) a bubbleless equilibrium coexists with a continuum of bubbly equilibria, and (3) all equilibria are bubbly. Under stationary endowments and standard assumptions, we provide a complete characterization of the equilibrium set and the associated asset price dynamics. In this setting, a bubbly equilibrium exists if and only if the interest rate in the economy without the asset is strictly lower than the population growth rate and the sum of per capita dividends is finite. Second, we establish necessary and sufficient conditions for Pareto optimality. Finally, we investigate the relationship between asset price behaviors and the optimality of equilibria.

translated_title: 泡沫还是不泡沫：代际重叠经济体中的资产价格动态与最优性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2508.03230v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们研究一个具有支付股息的资产的代际重叠（OLG）交换经济。首先，我们基于外生参数推导出一般条件，这些条件产生三种不同的情景：（1）仅存在无泡沫均衡，（2）无泡沫均衡与连续统的泡沫均衡共存，以及（3）所有均衡均为泡沫均衡。在静态禀赋和标准假设下，我们提供了均衡集及相关资产价格动态的完整刻画。在这种设定下，泡沫均衡存在的充要条件是：无资产经济中的利率严格低于人口增长率，且人均股息之和有限。其次，我们建立了帕累托最优性的必要且充分条件。最后，我们研究了资产价格行为与均衡最优性之间的关系。
tldr: 本文通过代际重叠模型，基于外生参数完整刻画了资产泡沫均衡的存在条件，并建立了帕累托最优性的充要条件，揭示了资产价格动态与均衡最优性的内在联系。
en_tdlr: This paper fully characterizes asset bubble equilibrium conditions in an OLG model based on exogenous parameters, establishes necessary and sufficient conditions for Pareto optimality, and reveals the intrinsic link between asset price dynamics and equilibrium optimality.
